Overview

Erie is a city in PA with a population of 96,000. Lake Erie’s port city with Presque Isle State Park and a growing tourism sector. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.9.
